ve_nft_has_pending_earned_rewards.meaning: the veNFT involved in the merge (as from) or split holds pending earned rewards before the operation

earned_rewards_before_merge_split.meaning: amount of earned rewards attributable to the veNFT before the merge/split operation

earned_rewards_after_merge_split.meaning: amount of earned rewards still attributable to the owner after the merge/split operation

merge_or_split_occurred.meaning: a merge (with the veNFT as from) or a split involving the veNFT has been executed

token_with_pending_rewards_merged_or_spl.meaning: a token holding pending rewards was merged as the `from` side or was splitted, per the impact's scope

assumptions: The merge/split operation is the checked transition; the veNFT is the `from` side of a merge or the source of a split.
Earned rewards are measured in reward-token units and are attributable to the veNFT owner.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the numeric amount of pending earned rewards nor the exact post-operation reward balance; the conservation relation is symbolic and requires code-level binding of the before/after reward quantities.

limitations: The report asserts total loss of earned rewards but gives no numeric magnitudes; the conservation pattern encodes the qualitative before/after relation symbolically.
Only the selected impact loss_of_earned_rewards_on_merge_or_split is formalized; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
